deviations.what: Add optional Rule.placement (Placement: machine | actor | requirement) as a minor schema change; t1's h7 schema test 'no actor slot' is scoped to the rule's stages (trigger, condition, workflow, action), not its placement
deviations.reason: spec c10/c60 require a rule's trigger and condition to evaluate where the rule is placed; t1's criterion omitted the field and t7's resolver needs it

deviations.what: Secrets use grant instead of shushu: references are grant:<NAME>, values resolved with 'grant get NAME' (refuses hidden secrets), hidden secrets injected with 'grant run --inject VAR=NAME -- cmd'
deviations.reason: operator: grant is the new secrets command replacing shushu (grant list/get/run verified on spark)

deviations.what: add task t41: a 'culture-rules node' engine daemon in culture_rules/node that composes heartbeat + platform probe at start, event ingest, per-host and shared trigger consumers with rule placement, the Executor tick loop with real actor adapters (LimitedActor release on deliver) and the run reporter; plus retry/translate Mongo transient transaction errors in MongoStore
deviations.reason: t39's multi-host tests proved the merged pieces compose only through a test harness: no plan task owns a production loop, so the shipped product would never fire rules on a host by itself; t39 also found MongoStore.transaction leaks raw pymongo WriteConflict/TransientTransactionError. Operator approved adding t41 (wave 7, before docs/demo).
